__comment__: REALISTIC NATURAL RUBBER COAGULATION: Hevea latex is ~30-40% poly(cis-1,4-isoprene) particles stabilized by proteins and ammonia. Acid (acetic acid from vinegar, pH ~4) neutralizes negative charge, proteins denature, rubber particles coalesce into a lump. Historically: add vinegar or citrus, stir, wash. Salt (NaCl) also coagulates but less cleanly – used here because TFC vinegar fluid is optional. Real: 1L latex + 30ml 5% acetic acid -> ~350g dry rubber after pressing and smoking.
